{
  "name": "longhaul",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "Samuel Ballesteros"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": "https://github.com/sssamuelll/longhaul",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/sssamuelll/longhaul",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/sssamuelll/longhaul/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "description": "Makes your Claude Code week last: compacts between tasks, steers plan steps to Sonnet, shows the pace you can afford.",
  "keywords": [
    "usage limits",
    "context",
    "compaction",
    "sonnet",
    "subagents",
    "tokens"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "guard_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Guard mode",
      "description": "Compacts the conversation between tasks once it passes the soft limit, and at the end of a turn once it passes the hard limit. auto acts, ask asks first, off does nothing.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ask",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "classifier_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Classifier mode",
      "description": "Hands execution work (plan steps, mechanical edits, searches) to a Sonnet subagent and has Opus review the result. auto acts, ask has Claude ask first, off does nothing.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "ask",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "budget_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Budget mode",
      "description": "The meter above the prompt: context size, weekly use, and today against the pace that lasts until the reset. auto shows it, off hides it.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "health_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Health mode",
      "description": "Checks once per session what every session loads before any work (MCP tools, memory files, skills) and mentions it above the prompt at most once a week. /longhaul health always works. auto shows the heads-up, off hides it.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "soft_limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Soft limit (tokens)",
      "description": "Context size, in tokens, after which the guard compacts at the next safe moment between tasks.",
      "default": 150000,
      "min": 100000,
      "max": 1000000
    },
    "hard_limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Hard limit (tokens)",
      "description": "Context size, in tokens, after which the guard compacts at the end of the turn, even mid-task. Must be higher than the soft limit.",
      "default": 300000,
      "min": 100000,
      "max": 1000000
    },
    "rules_file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rules file",
      "description": "Absolute path to a JSON file of classifier rules that replaces the built-in ones. Empty uses the built-in rules.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
